nodes.name: prime_bit_prefix_drop_last

nodes.name: prime_bit_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: HA induction constructs the complete finite primality mask at every natural bound.

nodes.name: prime_bit_prefix_all_bits
nodes.summary: A primality mask consists of actual zero/one entries.

nodes.name: prime_count_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the exact prime count for every bound, including zero and one.

nodes.name: prime_count_bounded
nodes.summary: The exact prime count is at most the ambient finite interval length.

nodes.name: beta_sum_entry_le
nodes.summary: Every actual nonnegative summand is at most its actual finite sum.

nodes.name: prime_count_positive_above_one
nodes.summary: The actual prime two makes every prime count at bound at least two positive.

nodes.name: beta_product_bit_weighted_upper_power
nodes.summary: An actual bit-weighted finite product has the corresponding upper bound by a power of its actual bit sum.

nodes.name: beta_product_bit_weighted_lower_power
nodes.summary: An actual bit-weighted finite product has the corresponding lower bound by a power of its actual bit sum.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_choice_exists
nodes.summary: Construct each exact cutoff entry by decidable order and beta decoding.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_prefix_empty
nodes.summary: The empty cutoff prefix is valid for every source and threshold.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_prefix_drop_last
nodes.summary: Restrict an actual cutoff table to its preceding prefix.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_prefix_entry
nodes.summary: Every decoded cutoff entry obeys its actual below/above-threshold choice.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_prefix_extend
nodes.summary: Append an actual cutoff choice, preserving every previously coded entry.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the complete finite cutoff table by actual length induction.

nodes.name: beta_cutoff_count_comparison
nodes.summary: The full bit count is at most the cutoff index plus the actual count above that index.

nodes.name: binary_power_two_dominates_successor
nodes.summary: Actual powers of two dominate the successor of their exponent, by HA induction.

nodes.name: binary_power_two_order_reflects_exponent
nodes.summary: Weak order between actual powers of two reflects weak order of the exponents.

nodes.name: binary_power_two_strict_order_reflects_exponent
nodes.summary: Strict order between actual powers of two reflects strict exponent order.

nodes.name: pow_four_is_square_of_pow_two
nodes.summary: The actual fourth power-base value is the square of the actual binary power value.

nodes.name: central_binom_dominates_pow_two
nodes.summary: For n at least four, the central binomial coefficient dominates the actual 2^n value.

nodes.name: primorial_prefix_decoded_choice
nodes.summary: Every actually decoded dense primorial factor has its exact prime-or-one choice.

nodes.name: primorial_factor_choice_one_le
nodes.summary: Every dense primorial factor is at least one, including nonprime positions.

nodes.name: prime_contribution_prefix_decoded_choice
nodes.summary: Every decoded prime contribution has its actual valuation and power witness, or is one at a nonprime index.

nodes.name: central_binom_prime_mask_weighted_upper
nodes.summary: The actual central-binomial contribution product is bounded factorwise by 2n exactly at prime-mask positions.

nodes.name: primorial_cutoff_weighted_lower
nodes.summary: Every prime strictly beyond the cutoff contributes at least the cutoff to the actual primorial product.

nodes.name: central_binom_prime_count_power_bound
nodes.summary: The actual central binomial coefficient is at most (2n)^pi(N) whenever 2n is at most N; all factors and prime counts are constructed.

nodes.name: primorial_cutoff_count_power_bound
nodes.summary: The cutoff raised to the actual number of primes beyond it is bounded by the actual primorial.

nodes.name: binary_split_half_lower_bound
nodes.summary: A lower bound on a doubled input reflects to its actual binary quotient, including either remainder bit.

nodes.name: binary_split_successor_le_double_successor
nodes.summary: The successor of a binary-split exponent is at most twice the successor of its half.

nodes.name: double_successor_le_triple_above_one
nodes.summary: For h at least two, twice its successor is at most three times h.

nodes.name: binary_length_positive
nodes.summary: The established binary-length convention always has positive length, including zero input.

nodes.name: binary_length_nonzero_components
nodes.summary: Expose the actual lower and upper binary powers for a nonzero input without changing the BitLen definition.

nodes.name: binary_half_scale_bounds
nodes.summary: The power-of-two threshold at half the lower exponent has square at most N, while ell is at most both 2U and 3h.

nodes.name: pow_four_equals_binary_double
nodes.summary: Actual 4^n equals actual 2^(n+n), using only constructed powers and their checked product laws.

nodes.name: prime_cutoff_exponent_bound
nodes.summary: At a genuine binary-power cutoff U=2^h, h times the actual upper prime count is at most 2N.

nodes.name: chebyshev_upper_arithmetic
nodes.summary: The exact small-prime 2N and large-prime 6N budgets combine to the required 8N bound.

nodes.name: prime_count_chebyshev_upper
nodes.summary: The exact effective Chebyshev upper bound pi(N)*BitLen(N) <= 8N, including every N at least two.

nodes.name: binary_split_upper_bound
nodes.summary: An actual binary-split integer is at most twice its half plus one.

nodes.name: double_successor_le_triple_of_positive
nodes.summary: For positive A, twice A plus one is at most three times A.

nodes.name: binary_split_eight_bound
nodes.summary: An actual binary split whose half is bounded by a positive A is bounded by 8A.

nodes.name: central_binom_prime_count_exponent_bound
nodes.summary: Central-binomial growth and actual prime contributions force floor(N/2) <= BitLen(N)*pi(N) whenever the half is at least four.

nodes.name: prime_count_chebyshev_lower_large
nodes.summary: The required lower prime-count bound for all N at least eight, using the actual binary half and central coefficient.

nodes.name: prime_count_chebyshev_lower
nodes.summary: The exact effective Chebyshev lower bound N <= 8*pi(N)*BitLen(N), including every N at least two.

nodes.name: prime_count_chebyshev_bounds
nodes.summary: Exact G027: for every N at least two and its actual prime count and binary length, N <= 8*pi(N)*BitLen(N) and pi(N)*BitLen(N) <= 8N.

nodes.name: prime_bit_choice_functional
nodes.summary: The primality indicator is uniquely zero or one, without a classical principle.

nodes.name: prime_bit_prefix_equal_entry
nodes.summary: Primality masks with different beta codes have equal entries at every actual shared index.

nodes.name: prime_count_functional
nodes.summary: The exact prime count is independent of every mask and sum-trace encoding choice.

nodes.name: prime_count_zero
nodes.summary: The exact prime count at zero is zero.

nodes.name: prime_count_one
nodes.summary: One contributes no prime: the exact prime count at one is zero.

nodes.name: prime_count_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every bound has a genuinely constructed, uniquely determined exact prime count.

nodes.name: BetaAt

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Prime
nodes.summary: p is nonunit and every factorization of p has a unit factor.

nodes.name: PrimeBitPrefix
nodes.summary: At each index i<l the actual bit is one exactly when S i is prime, and otherwise zero.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: PrimeCount
nodes.summary: The actual finite sum of the complete primality mask through N: exactly the number of primes at most N.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: BetaCutoffPrefix
nodes.summary: Actual copied source entries at indices at least u, and zero below u; applied to a primality mask this selects primes strictly greater than u.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: z is the product of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: Repeat
nodes.summary: The decoded prefix repeats a for l positions.

nodes.name: Pow
nodes.summary: z is the relational e-th power of a.

nodes.name: PowTwo
nodes.summary: The exact existing constructive exponentiation relation Pow(2,e,p).

nodes.name: BitLen
nodes.summary: The unique binary length, with BitLen(0,1) and positive bounds 2^(ell-1)≤n<2^ell.

nodes.name: Primorial
nodes.summary: z is the finite product of the primes at most n.

nodes.name: Choose
nodes.summary: z is the recurrence-defined binomial coefficient of row n and column k.

nodes.name: CentralBinom
nodes.summary: z is the central binomial coefficient Choose(2n,n).
